detail.longDescription: At this point, announcements about new AI agents trigger a very "Florals? For spring? Groundbreaking." response in me—which also means I've gotten very good at tuning them out. Muse, Meta's new personal AI agent, almost got that response from me too. But it piqued my interest the good ol' fashioned way: with a wide-eyed mascot that triggers a level of cute aggression I haven't experienced since seeing Despicable Me. Mascot aside, Muse is actually worth paying attention to. Here's everything yo
